page_title: ROM 1-0 LEC | AS Roma v Lecce 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) has received a yellow card for his foul.
89' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Juan Luca Sacchi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Ylber Ramadani and he is replaced by Alex Sala (Lecce).
86' Antonio Arena (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti did his best and is replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
85' AS Roma get a corner.
85' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
81' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is booked by the referee.
80' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) replacing Lorenzo Pellegrini.
79' Good work from AS Roma as they win a corner.
77' Angelino (AS Roma) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
75' Donyell Malen goes off the pitch and Antonio Arena (AS Roma) comes on.
75' Substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Angelino (AS Roma).

70' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
67' Lameck Banda is substituted due to injury. Eusebio Di Francesco gives a chance to Konan Ndri (Lecce).
67' Lameck Banda (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) prepares to take a corner kick.
61' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Omri Gandelman will be replaced by Sadik Fofana (Lecce).
61' Nikola Stulic comes off the pitch to be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Lecce).
60' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
59' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
57' 1 - 0 Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
56' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
55' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
55' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
53' Lecce are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
51' Here is a change. Neil El Aynaoui is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).
48' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Gianluca Mancini comes off for Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' AS Roma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
43' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
41' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
39' The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
39' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
37' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lecce in a dangerous position.

35' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
33' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce have a free kick.
33' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
30' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
28' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 5:5.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
23' 73:27 – the ratio of ball possession.
22' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce win a free kick.
20' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
16' Wonderful movement by AS Roma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
14' The possession of the ball – 79:21.

10' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
7' Flag goes up against Donyell Malen (AS Roma) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will take a corner kick.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AS Roma are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
